Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the lineage. After WebSurfer confirmed that Albert IV’s father (John II) was the son of Albert II, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Albert I (Albert II’s father) was the paternal grandfather. This conflated the grandfather with the great-grandfather. The correct paternal grandfather is Albert II, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst.
